title: "Schedule"
---

Class meets Mondays from 4:00 to 5:00 PM in KC2 213, September 28 - November 30, 2026. A kick-off bootcamp will be held Thursday, September 24 from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM in the KC2 Seminar Room.

Lecture slides are posted after each class (L00-L10). [Book](book/index.html) reading lists the chapters (Ch.) and reference appendices (App.) to read for that week; see the [Syllabus](Syllabus.qmd) for what each section covers.
